# shumoku_topology (Data Source)

Looks up a topology by `id` or by exact `name`. A name must match exactly one topology.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "shumoku_topology" "campus" {
  name = "Campus network"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Topology id.
- `name` (String) Exact topology name.

### Read-Only

- `composition_mode` (String) `additive` or `enrichment`.
- `created_at` (Number) Creation time, Unix milliseconds.
- `scope_mode` (String) `auto`, `open` or `closed`.
- `updated_at` (Number) Last update time, Unix milliseconds.
